title: Cloud Storage Privacy Risk Calculator - Assess Your Data Security
metaDescription: Calculate your cloud storage privacy risk score. Evaluate provider security, encryption, and data protection to keep your files safe from breaches.
description: Assess your cloud storage privacy risks with our comprehensive calculator. Evaluate your provider's security practices, encryption methods, and data protection features to understand how well your files are protected from unauthorized access.

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall privacy risk assessment (0-100, lower is better)

outputFields.label: Primary Recommendation
outputFields.description: Most important step to improve your privacy

formula: const accessScores = { 'can-read': 60, 'partly': 35, 'cannot': 15, 'unsure': 65 }; const dataTypeScores = { 'personal': 10, 'business': 25, 'financial': 40, 'medical': 45, 'legal': 35, 'creative': 20 }; const encryptionReduction = { 'none': 0, 'manual': -25, 'zero-knowledge': -30, 'third-party': -20 }; const sharingScores = { 'never': 0, 'rare': 5, 'occasional': 10, 'frequent': 20, 'daily': 30 }; let baseScore = accessScores[providerAccess] ?? 65; baseScore += dataTypeScores[dataTypes] ?? 10; baseScore += encryptionReduction[encryptionUsed] ?? 0; baseScore += sharingScores[sharingFrequency] ?? 10; if (!twoFactor) baseScore += 15; if (dataAmount > 100) baseScore += 5; if (dataAmount > 500) baseScore += 10; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseScore)); let riskLevel, recommendation; if (riskScore <= 25) { riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; recommendation = 'Keep 2FA on and review your shared links from time to time.'; } else if (riskScore <= 50) { riskLevel = 'Moderate Risk'; recommendation = 'Turn on 2FA if it is off, and move sensitive files to end-to-end encrypted storage.'; } else if (riskScore <= 75) { riskLevel = 'High Risk'; recommendation = 'Switch to zero-knowledge providers and encrypt sensitive files before upload.'; } else { riskLevel = 'Critical Risk'; recommendation = 'Move sensitive files to end-to-end encrypted storage now and turn on every security feature your account offers.'; } return { riskScore, riskLevel, recommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your cloud storage privacy risk based on whether your provider can open your files, data sensitivity, encryption usage, account security, and sharing habits. Scores range from 0-100, with lower scores indicating better privacy protection.
tips: Use zero-knowledge encrypted providers like Proton Drive or Tresorit for sensitive data
Always enable two-factor authentication on your cloud storage accounts
Encrypt sensitive files locally before uploading to any cloud service
Regularly review and revoke sharing permissions for old files and folders
Review which apps and devices can access your cloud account, and remove the ones you no longer use

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy practices with minimal risk of data exposure

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Good practices but room for improvement in encryption and provider choice

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy vulnerabilities that should be addressed soon

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Immediate action needed to protect your data from unauthorized access
